label: Narodowy Bank Polski - kursy walut
terms_note: Open API, no key; documentation in Polish (and English) at api.nbp.pl, HTML only. Docs vs live 2026-10-01: the docs say a single query 'nie może obejmować przedziału dłuższego, niż 93 dni' (93 days), but the service accepts up to 367 days and answers '400 BadRequest - Przekroczony limit 367 dni / Limit of 367 days has been exceeded' beyond that. Errors are plain text: '404 NotFound - Not Found - Brak danych' for an unknown currency or a range without data. JSON is requested with format=json (the default follows the Accept header).

search_symbols.note: Currencies of table A (average rates), with Polish names (dolar amerykański, euro ...); symbol is 'A/<code>' as get_series takes it. Table B (less common currencies) and C (bid/ask) series also work in get_series ('B/<code>', 'C/<code>').

get_series.note: PLN per unit of a currency for every fixing day from start to end (both REQUIRED, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 367 days apart). series_id is '<table>/<code>': A/USD, A/EUR, B/AED; table C gives the ask rate.

not_offered.get_candles: No OHLC data (gold prices and fixings only).

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
